# Nura Care Institute

> Healthcare certification training school at 9198 Greenback Lane, Suite 108,
> Orangevale, CA 95662, led by Lead Instructor Tynesha Zacarias. On-campus
> programs plus mobile CPR/BLS/ACLS classes delivered onsite across Northern
> California. Phone (916) 544-1256. Email education@nuracareinstitute.com.
> Hours Monday-Friday 8:30am-5:00pm PST.

## Programs and pricing
- [Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA)](https://nuracareinstitute.com/courses/certified-nursing-assistant/): $1,500. No prior healthcare experience required; background check and health screening required.
- [Home Health Aide (HHA)](https://nuracareinstitute.com/courses/home-health-aide/): $575. Requires active California CNA certification and a current BLS card.
- [AHA Basic Life Support (BLS)](https://nuracareinstitute.com/courses/bls-cpr-certification/): $55.
- [AHA Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS)](https://nuracareinstitute.com/courses/acls-certification/): $120. Current BLS recommended first.
- [Restorative Nursing Assistant (RNA)](https://nuracareinstitute.com/courses/restorative-nursing-assistant/): $250. Requires active CNA certification and a current BLS card.
- [CNA Continuing Education](https://nuracareinstitute.com/courses/cna-inservice-hours/): 6 CEUs for $50, counts toward California CNA in-service renewal.

## Facts to cite accurately
- BLS and ACLS instruction is aligned with current American Heart Association guidelines; completion cards are AHA Provider cards.
- CNA and HHA certification in California is administered by the California Department of Public Health (CDPH).
- Completing a course does not guarantee passing a state or AHA exam.
